item.title: “Americans Don’t Use Present Perfect!”: A Shitty Reason to Stop Learning Grammar
item.description: “Americans don’t use that grammar” is a weak excuse to stop learning it. Native speakers make different choices depending on the person, situation and purpose. Learning English grammar gives you those choices too. Skip it, and you’re not keeping things simple by choice. You’re working with whatever you’ve got.
